853:t_63:5.en:
$$クラン$$
「As captain of the $$ピクシー$$ Platoon, I have to fight for them.」

853:t_63:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh, come now~. Aren't you fighting for your beloved $$ミシェル$$?」

853:t_63:8.en:
$$クラン$$
「N-no, I take that back! I can't say I have no such intention, but as a $$ゼントラン$$, that sort of thing is...」

853:t_63:9.en:
$$クラン$$
「B-but... We are $$ゼントラン$$s awakened to culture! And if culture is love, then fighting for $$ミシェル$$ is...」

853:t_63:10.en:
$$クラン$$
「N-no... I have my responsibilities as captain...」

853:t_63:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(This is amusing, so I'll keep watching, but... How long will it go on...?)

853:t_64:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Who would you like to share this joy with?」

853:t_64:5.en:
$$カナリア$$
「I'd share it with my beloved son, $$エディ$$.」

853:t_64:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I see! When I look at you, $$カナリア$$, I can truly feel the meaning of 'Mothers are strong.'」

853:t_64:7.en:
$$カナリア$$
「That's right, $$ＡＧ$$. If it's to protect $$エディ$$, nothing frightens me.」

853:t_64:8.en:
$$カナリア$$
「Naturally, a robot with who knows what schemes is no threat at all.」

853:t_64:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Ugh... I was going to cling to her and call her 'Mommy~,' but now I can't make a move...)

853:t_65:4.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「So this is how you congratulate an ace pilot.」

853:t_65:6.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「No... I've always fought as ordered, so it makes me happy to have someone congratulate me like this...」

853:t_65:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You are a human being now, $$ブレラ$$, rather than a fighting machine. I recommend living as a human should.」

853:t_65:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$ランカ$$ is a grown woman now too. Please seek your own happiness, $$ブレラ$$.」

853:t_65:9.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「You're right... If I keep staying this way forever, $$ランカ$$ will worry about me too...」

853:t_65:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(It seems he won't be able to leave $$ランカ$$'s side for quite a while yet...)

853:t_65:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Well... They are siblings who were separated. He can indulge his sister complex until he's satisfied.)

853:t_66:4.en:
$$竜馬$$
「This still isn't enough. A hundred or two hundred enemies won't be enough to stop my blood boiling.」

853:t_66:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You live up to your reputation, $$竜馬$$... But warriors need rest too.」

853:t_66:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I recommend relaxing when you are away from battle.」

853:t_66:7.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Then train with me to help me unwind, $$ＡＧ$$.」

853:t_66:8.en:
$$竜馬$$
「I'll use you to work off my stress.」

853:t_66:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「W-when you say it with that smile, it doesn't sound like a joke...」

853:t_67:4.en:
$$隼人$$
「Heh... I'm being congratulated by the last guy you'd associate with words of blessing.」

853:t_67:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now, don't say that. Please simply enjoy the occasion.」

853:t_67:6.en:
$$隼人$$
「Every enemy machine I shoot down brings us one machine closer to peace... If I think of it that way, it's something to be happy about.」

853:t_67:7.en:
$$隼人$$
「But the fighting isn't over yet. I'll keep striking down enemies until the day we regain peace.」

853:t_67:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Whatever they may say, $$隼人$$ and $$竜馬$$ are essentially the same...)

853:t_67:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(You truly are one of the warriors chosen by the $$ゲッター線$$... Don't forget that you too are being drawn into an endless battle without realizing it.)

853:t_68:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「After talking to $$竜馬$$ and $$隼人$$, your presence is a breath of fresh air, $$弁慶$$.」

853:t_68:6.en:
$$弁慶$$
「I'm a gentle old guy as long as you keep your hands off $$渓$$.」

853:t_68:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You needn't worry. With a tomboy like $$渓$$...」

853:t_68:8.en:
$$弁慶$$
「What the hell do you know about $$渓$$!?」

853:t_68:10.en:
$$弁慶$$
「Listen, $$ＡＧ$$! $$渓$$ may seem like a boy at first, but she's a kind, considerate woman!」

853:t_68:11.en:
$$弁慶$$
「What's more, if she does her hair and puts on a little makeup...」

853:t_68:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Ah... This should have ended on a peaceful note, but I stepped on a land mine myself...)

853:t_69:4.en:
$$甲児$$
「I'm not satisfied with this much. I'm aiming to be $c's ace, and then the strongest man in the universe!」

853:t_69:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's quite a leap in scale from when you were $$熱海$$'s secret delinquent boss.」

853:t_69:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(...Jeez... He's no different from his delinquent-boss days...)

853:t_69:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Please pay no mind to a petty dimensional trader like me, $$甲児$$, and aim to be the universe's strongest man.」

853:t_69:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(At times like this, flattery is the best way to get through it quickly.)

853:t_69:13.en:
$$甲児$$
「I said... I can hear you.」

853:t_70:4.en:
$$さやか$$
「Thank you, $$ＡＧ$$. But don't come any closer.」

853:t_70:6.en:
$$さやか$$
「Of course I am, considering everything you've done.」

853:t_70:7.en:
$$さやか$$
「Just so you know, trying to win my pity won't work this time either.」

853:t_70:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「B-but... It's your fault for being so attractive, $$さやか$$!」

853:t_70:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You're a beautiful girl with a great body! And you're both graceful and strong! No man could fail to fall for you!」

853:t_70:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(My plan seems likely to succeed, just like the North Wind and the Sun...)

853:t_71:4.en:
$$ボス$$
「Yeah! Now I'm $c's great ace in both name and deed!」

853:t_71:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「In both name and deed, you say... Does that mean you were already an ace in name alone...?」

853:t_71:6.en:
$$ボス$$
「You bet. As they say, a talented hawk hides its butt.」

853:t_71:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I understand. I'll gracefully ignore the joke and ask the $$くろがね五人衆$$ about that.」

853:t_71:8.en:
$$ボス$$
「Ah, I was lying! Hold on a minute!」

853:t_71:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Don't worry, $$ボス$$. I'm sure they'll train you to live up to the name of ace.」

853:t_72:4.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Yes... Words of praise are pleasing to hear.」

853:t_72:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then, let me take this chance... Hey! You're the dashing man of $$オリュンポス$$! You're the galaxy's Big Bro who guides humanity!」

853:t_72:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You truly are the god among gods! You're the War God of Light! You're a model for higher-dimensional life forms!」
